You are a subagent spawned by another session.
Implement Phase E7 (Solana A+ Touch) of the Financial Resilience Engine in "/Users/ajeet/Projects/Hackathons/Sheridan Datathon 2026". Gated, ~1 hour budget. E1-E6 complete (HEAD 4d9ff25). Design and gate rules are recorded in docs/decisions.md (entries "Phase E7: Static memo receipts mounted in the verdict card" and docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). Read those first plus docs/solana.md (wording contract) and src/components/judge/ReceiptBadge.tsx (KEEP verdict: must stay byte-identical).

## Concurrent-session warning
Another session has UNCOMMITTED work in the tree: scripts/engine/atlas.py, weather_state.py, test_atlas.py, weather_state_goldens.json, build.py, verify.py, public/data/engine/atlas.json, docs/devpost.md, src/components/atlas/probe.test.tsx. DO NOT touch, stage, or commit any of them. Your changes are strictly the E7 set below.

## STEP 0: GATE CHECK (report each; any failure -> gate-failure path, see bottom)
1. Root memo: read scripts/solana/evidence/memo-devnet.json — confirm signature present, confirmation_status finalized, matches_local true. Recompute SHA256 of public/data/findings.json and assert it equals the evidence payload_sha256. Mismatch = gate failure.
2. Re-runs green: `uv run python -m scripts.engine.verify` (PASS, sha256 9ec428bf...), `uv run pytest -q` (170 passing incl. the concurrent atlas tests — if ANY failure exists not caused by you, report it), `npx vitest run` (527 passing).
3. Network/wallet: `solana balance --url devnet` (or uv run equivalent per scripts/solana/ tooling — read send_memo.py header for the exact invocation pattern and prerequisites). If balance is 0 and faucet unavailable -> cut receipts 2/3, skip to bundling with root only.

## STEP 1: SEND RECEIPT 2 (inside the gate, 60 min total cap)
model_card.json hash memo per scripts/solana/send_memo.py usage (read its argparse first). Evidence to scripts/solana/evidence/memo-devnet-modelcard.json. Confirm the tx on devnet. Prefix wording per the approved package: "Sheridan Datathon 2026 model_card.json" style (see docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md exact prefixes).

## STEP 2: SEND RECEIPT 3 (F1 aggregate fingerprint)
Extract the F1 aggregate table: `uv run python -c "import json; print(json.dumps(json.load(open('public/data/findings.json'))['f1StructuralVsDiscretionary'], sort_keys=True))" > build/f1-aggregate-table.json`, send with prefix "Sheridan Datathon 2026 F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows", evidence to scripts/solana/evidence/memo-devnet-fingerprint.json, confirm on devnet. If time/budget pressure: this is the FIRST cut.

## STEP 3: BUNDLE
cp evidence siblings into public/data/: memo-devnet.json, memo-devnet-modelcard.json, memo-devnet-fingerprint.json (root always; 2/3 as landed).

## STEP 4: src/data/receipts.ts + receipts.test.ts
```ts
export interface ChainReceipt { role: 'root' | 'modelcard' | 'fingerprint'; sourceFile: string; signature: string; payloadSha256: string; cluster: string; confirmedAt: string; explorerUrl: string; evidenceHref: string; label: string; matchesLocal: boolean }
export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null  // hand-written guard, null on any shape violation
export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[]  // import.meta.glob eager over public/data/memo-devnet*.json; missing files simply absent; root first
export function toMemoEvidence(receipt): MemoEvidence | null  // maps to ReceiptBadge props: verified <- matchesLocal, signature, label
export function evidenceHref(filename: string): string  // dataBase() + 'data/' + filename
```
Labels: root "findings.json root memo, devnet", modelcard "model_card.json hash, devnet", fingerprint "F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows".
Tests: parse guards (valid, matches_local false -> unverified path, malformed -> null, missing signature); DIGEST HONESTY: node:crypto SHA256 of public/data/findings.json equals ROOT payloadSha256 (and model_card.json when its receipt exists); registry only returns existing files, root first; dash clean.

## STEP 5: src/components/console/ReceiptStamp.tsx + test + index.css styles
Renders: anchor wrapping <ReceiptBadge evidence={toMemoEvidence(root)} /> with href=root.evidenceHref, target _blank, rel noreferrer, title "Bundored receipt, written at build time. Opens the local evidence file." (exact honest wording, no dashes); explorer anchor to root.explorerUrl same attrs; compact receipt rows (label, short signature first 8 chars, evidence link, explorer link) per receipt; note line "Anchored at build time on Solana devnet when the analysis was frozen. This page reads the bundled evidence files only and never writes to chain." Props: { receipts?: ChainReceipt[] } override for tests (default loadBundledReceipts()). When no receipts: ReceiptBadge gets null evidence -> renders its pinned "no evidence yet" placeholder, zero rows.
Styles: append cp-receipt-stamp / cp-receipt-row / cp-receipt-link / cp-receipt-note to the cp- block in src/index.css (do not disturb existing rules).

## STEP 6: THE SEAM (one pre-existing file touched)
src/components/console/BaselineCard.tsx: +1 import ReceiptStamp, +1 JSX line <ReceiptStamp /> immediately after the existing cp-provenance paragraph. Nothing else.

## STEP 7: REGISTRATION + GATES
- src/dashScan.test.ts: register src/data/receipts.ts, receipts.test.ts, ReceiptStamp.tsx + test (explicit or AUTO_DIRS per existing patterns).
- Full gates: npx vitest run (527 + new), npm run typecheck, npm run build (proves import.meta.glob resolves), uv run pytest -q (170), uv run python -m scripts.engine.verify (PASS sha256 unchanged).
- PROOF: git diff on src/components/judge/ReceiptBadge.tsx and its test is EMPTY (byte-identical scaffold).

## STEP 8: DO NOT commit (orchestrator will); do not stage anything; leave the concurrent session's files dirty.

## STEP 9: write-up sentence routing (do NOT edit docs/devpost.md, the other session owns it): output the exact approved sentence in your report for the orchestrator to route:
"future work: a behavioral score attested on chain could gate a credit line or automate surplus sweeps; not implemented, and the underlying model (F3, AUC 0.590) is not strong enough to gate credit"

## GATE-FAILURE PATH (any step-0 failure or send failure): bundle whatever evidence exists, still build receipts.ts/ReceiptStamp/BaselineCard seam (placeholder state is an acceptable ship state), skip the write-up sentence, record the reason in your report. Never leave the tree broken.

## HARD CONSTRAINTS
- Zero runtime network in shipped code: import.meta.glob eager only; the only network affordances are plain <a> links (bundled evidence file, explorer URL). No fetch of receipts, no RPC, no SDK.
- No wallet UI, no Anchor, no tokens, no 3D, no runtime RPC (scope lock).
- No em/en dashes, double or spaced hyphens in any new string/comment.
- ReceiptBadge.tsx and its test BYTE-IDENTICAL (wrapping anchor lives in ReceiptStamp).
- Do not touch: judge/ (except reading ReceiptBadge), App.tsx, ConsoleView, consoleStore, judge-sheet, scripts/engine/* except none, public/data/engine/, the concurrent files listed above.

If you need clarification or encounter ambiguity, output your questions in this exact format at the TOP of your response:

## QUESTIONS FOR USER
- Q1: [your question]

Then continue with your best-effort output based on available information.

Report: gate check results (with tx signatures for 2/3 or cut reason), files created, digest honesty results, all gate outputs, ReceiptBadge byte-identity proof, deviations, and the routed write-up sentence.

1: # Storm Fund Decision Records
2: 
3: Last updated: Sun Nov 08 2026
4: 
5: ## Nov 04 2026: Phase 0: Stack and gameplay architecture
6: 
7: **Context**: 48-hour solo hackathon with a 24-hour execution budget, static
8: GitHub Pages deliverable, live booth play and a 2-minute demo video, and a
9: "serious analysis wearing a game" judge story demanding non-dashboard viz.
10: 
11: **Decision**: React 19 + R3F 9 + drei + Zustand 5 + Vite 6 (exact versions from
12: the zenith-web and Talon reference repos), offline Python/uv data pipeline to
13: world.json, game logic in a pure TS command bus and reducer, on-rails transfers
14: (no free flight), auto-demo as deterministic command replay, 2.5D Canvas
15: fallback pre-committed at event hour 6.
16: 
17: **Rationale**: Declarative 3D gives the highest wow per hour when scaffolding is
18: copied from two working repos; a pure reducer makes gameplay testable and the
19: auto-demo deterministic; on-rails avoids the physics tuning black hole.
20: 
21: **Trade-offs**: No free-flight feel, no postprocessing on weak GPUs, no deep
22: links, and world.json must be regenerated when the CSV schema shifts. All are
23: acceptable for a 24-hour static deliverable.
24: 
25: ## Nov 04 2026: Phase 0: User approvals and open items
26: 
27: **Approved**: shortlist B-1 Delta-V Budget (primary) + C-2 Attrition FC
28: (backup), with G-1 Ledger Valley and G-3 Colony Glass as data-insurance
29: fallbacks. P0 pre-build list approved. Judges play live, so click or two-key
30: controls plus a visible auto-demo are mandatory. Procedural pixel art only.
31: IBM skin flavor is employees as people (Colony Glass), not infrastructure.
32: 
33: **User modifications to the plan**:
34: 1. True 3D gameplay wanted (inclined orbits, vis-viva delta-v that matters),
35:    with research required to confirm feasibility. 2D is acceptable if it can
36:    carry a unique and beautiful aesthetic.
37: 2. Booth machine is self-provided, so WebGL2 risk is ours to control and the
38:    2D fallback renderer drops from P0 to P1 insurance.
39: 3. ElevenLabs API key and credits not yet confirmed, so live narration is P1
40:    until verified. Pre-generated narration files are the interim plan.
41: 
42: **Open (closed Nov 04 2026)**: renderer decision resolved by research output;
43: Tier T1 on-rails true 3D with a 2D CRT phosphor fallback, see docs/research.md.
44: 
45: ## Nov 04 2026: Phase 0: Findings-first hybrid (SUPERSEDES game-primary ordering)
46: 
47: **Context**: User challenged whether a game can count as a data finding under
48: the 2026 rubric. Research confirmed the actual weights: Discovery 35, Data Use
49: 25, Communication 25, Impact 15. Execution weight was removed for 2026 and the
50: organizer message is "judged on what you found rather than what you shipped".
51: 60 percent of the score is Discovery plus Data Use, which a game does not
52: automatically produce. Prior winners: Sheridan 2025 first place was Sourced
53: (interactive 3D artifact); games at data events tend to win category prizes,
54: not podiums.
55: 
56: **Decision**: Findings-first hybrid. The site leads with a findings report
57: (question, methods, numbered findings F1 to F5 with chart twins, model card,
58: limitations); the game is the exploration layer one click below. Tier 0
59: analysis is built BEFORE any further game work. Hard condition: if Tier 0
60: findings are not computed and rendered by Saturday 2:00 PM, the game drops to
61: presentation-only and the entry ships as a professional analysis with a 3D
62: interactive appendix.
63: 
64: **Primary target**: Best Data Visualization and Storytelling track (native
65: format award, no Best UI/UX competitor in 2026). Podium is secondary.
66: 
67: **Write-up**: single source of truth; the site findings report is copied into
68: the Devpost description.
69: 
70: **Dataset fallback**: if the real Tangerine dataset never lands or is unusable,
71: ship findings computed on the mock ledger, loudly labeled as synthetic. Do not
72: pivot to a public dataset.
73: 
74: **Rationale**: every game mechanic must pass four tests (falsifiable finding,
75: novel object that charts show worse, conventional chart twin, row-level
76: provenance). F4, the plane-change cost metric (counterfactual cash-flow timing
77: friction), is the load-bearing finding the game exists to make legible.
78: 
79: **Tier 0 (mandatory before the Saturday 8:00 PM draft)**: EDA section,
80: recurrence and seasonality analysis (F1, F2), deficit-day logistic regression
81: with model card (F3), findings report page (F4, F5 counterfactual module
82: shared between report and game reducer).
83: 
84: **Trade-offs**: less game polish in the window; findings work starts first,
85: game polish is Sunday morning only. The uniqueness advantage is kept rather
86: than traded away for a plain dashboard.
87: 
88: ## Nov 05 2026 - Phase 1: Report UI and shared counterfactual module deferred to next phase
89: 
90: **Context**: The code review cycle required a landing page that is not an
91: empty promise while the full report UI was not yet built.
92: 
93: **Decision**: The FindingsView ships a stopgap: a data-driven summary of the
94: five findings (titles, one headline number each, synthetic-data badge) loaded
95: from findings.json, with tests. The FULL report UI (SVG chart twins, honesty
96: badges, explore-in-game deep link) and the shared F4/F5 counterfactual module
97: that both the report and the game reducer consume are moved to the next
98: approved phase (Phase 1, currently in progress per AGENTS.md status).
99: 
100: **Rationale**: the stopgap keeps the findings-first landing honest without
101: blocking the review cycle; the chart twins need the renderer decision and the
102: shared module needs the game option card designed first.
103: 
104: **Status**: stopgap implemented and tested. SUPERSEDED later the same day:
105: the full report UI (SVG chart twins, provenance stamps, explore-in-game deep
106: link) shipped in Phase 1 and is now live; see the Phase 1 review trail in
107: docs/reviews.md. Only the shared F4/F5 counterfactual module stayed deferred
108: until Phase 2 (shipped, see below).
109: 
110: ## Nov 05 2026 - Phase 2: Counterfactual bridge shipped
111: 
112: **Context**: The findings-first story requires the report and the game to read
113: the same counterfactual numbers so the figure a judge reads in finding F4 is
114: the identical figure they see in the game.
115: 
116: **Decision**: The bridge is src/lib/friction.ts, one pure typed lookup
117: (lookupFriction) that both surfaces call: the transfer option card in the game
118: and the F4 section of the report. It reads only findings.json data, never
119: recomputes. The card tag is text ("simulated counterfactual, see F4") rather
120: than a link because the app has no router. PlayView reuses the memoized
121: loadSharedFindingsReport so findings.json stays a single fetch with two
122: consumers. Category matching is case-insensitive name plus entity id tail;
123: income targets and unknown categories render no line rather than a guess.
124: 
125: **Rationale**: one shared lookup makes drift between surfaces impossible by
126: construction, which is the point of the bridge.
127: 
128: ## Nov 06 2026 - Phase 3: Comprehensive award plan synthesis (LOCKED)
129: 
130: **Context**: Friday before the hackathon. User set five award targets:
131: podium, Tangerine (preferred sponsor), Best Use of Entire, Best Use of Solana,
132: Best Domain Name (GoDaddy). Money River landscape art is the artistic spine.
133: Real Tangerine data drops Saturday. Fresh repo Saturday with Entire from day
134: one, plumbing imported from this sandbox.
135: 
136: **Decisions (user confirmed Nov 06)**:
137: 1. Solana scope: memo anchor ONLY (devnet receipt anchoring the findings.json
138:    SHA256 checksum plus footer read-back). No wallet UI, no Anchor, no on-chain
139:    river, no tokens. Hard stop Saturday 5:30 PM, drop track if not green.
140:    Rationale: past MLH Solana winners shipped memo proof layers; track text
141:    only requires on-chain state or transactions.
142: 2. Award priority and cut order: podium (via viz craft) first, Tangerine
143:    second, Solana third, Entire fourth, GoDaddy fifth.
144: 3. Fresh repo: user creates it Saturday and names it as the work proceeds.
145:    Import is a whitelisted copy (scripts/, src/, docs/, configs, workflows);
146:    base path must be fixed in the same commit as the import; migration fails
147:    closed until CI and Pages are green.
148: 4. Real data privacy: decide by data type on Saturday. Sponsor competition
149:    data may be committed raw; personal statement data publishes aggregates,
150:    checksums, and k=10 suppressed cells only, never raw rows.
151: 5. Best Beginner track skipped (not eligible). Entire is a serious secondary
152:    target: Friday rehearsal here gates GO; 45 minute Saturday setup timebox;
153:    evidence = tokens profile x2, graph stats, one Trail, token A/B.
154: 6. IBM and ElevenLabs tracks not selected (Tangerine is the sponsor play).
155:    Gemini/Tiger/Snowflake/Vultr not selected (prior assessment).
156: 
157: **Story**: "One year of a Tangerine ledger painted as a river landscape, then
158: the same brush pointed at an open ledger on Solana." Site: hero Money River
159: landscape art (water = daily balance, drought stones = deficit days, payday
160: bridges, ghost line = F4, high-water mark = F5), findings first, Solana
161: section E (memo anchor), Entire build-log paragraph, links.
162: 
163: **Hard stops**: Entire setup 45 min (Sat) with abort; Solana Sat 5:30 PM;
164: findings freeze Sat 6:00 PM; Devpost draft Sat 8:00 PM (hard); code freeze
165: Sun 9:00 AM; submit Sun 12:00 PM; demos 12:30 PM.
166: 
167: **Friday foundation (tonight)**: Entire rehearsal here (60 min, GATE on
168: `entire session tokens` returning numbers), export/import dry run, Tangerine
169: ingest adapter (15-step schema inference, tested on mock), Solana toolchain
170: pre-verify (CLI, faucet, memo send from scratch), Money River art skeleton on
171: mock data, decision doc committed.
172: 
173: ## Nov 07 2026 - Gated Solana provenance set approved
174: 
175: **Context**: a concept assessment round (planner plus product manager)
176: adjudicated external Tangerine x Solana bridge ideas (behavioral credit
177: scoring, yield streaming, dual-layer dashboards, risk-shield particles) and
178: the planner additions against the locked Nov 06 plan. Full record with the
179: verdict table: docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md.
180: 
181: **Decision**: approve a gated micro-addition to the memo anchor: a three
182: receipt provenance set (findings.json root memo, model_card.json hash, F1
183: aggregate fingerprint memo), a static chain-receipt panel in section E
184: reading bundled evidence, and one explicitly labeled not-built future-work
185: paragraph in the write-up. Gate conditions: root memo confirmed by the
186: 4:30 PM decision line (5:30 PM death line), findings re-run verified green
187: first, 60 minute cap, paid from cut-order items (devnet stone, motion
188: accents); gate failure ships the single memo and skips silently. Every
189: other assessed concept is rejected (SolCash credit line, yield streamer,
190: live dual-layer dashboard, risk-shield particles, fake-oracle framing,
191: payday commitment, memo escrow, resilience reputation, streaks/duels);
192: evidence filenames and commands: docs/competition-day-runbook.md Phase 6.
193: 
194: **Rationale**: the proof-layer pattern matches Solana track winners; the
195: package passes the single-story and deception tests; it is paid from the
196: cut order rather than new budget, so the findings-first primary and the
197: video are untouched.
198: 
199: ## Nov 07 2026 - Phase E1: Profile precompute contract for the resilience engine
200: 
201: **Context**: live judging needs every judge number for any account_id
202: computed before the booth opens, with the exact branch rules of
203: docs/tangerine-challenge.md, and the E1 build was resumed from an
204: interrupted session. Reviewing the on-disk modules against the checklist
205: surfaced two places where the checklist could not hold against the real

10: run against any other cluster. No real funds are ever involved; devnet SOL
11: has no value. Localnet runs live in localnet_selftest.py instead.

14:     uv run --with solders==0.29.0 python scripts/solana/send_memo.py \
15:         --text "Ledger Odyssey test"

41: DEVNET_GENESIS_HASH = "REDACTED"

43:     "REDACTED"

45: DEFAULT_KEYPAIR = Path.home() / ".config" / "solana" / "id.json"

48: POLL_INTERVAL_S = 1.5

52: def rpc_call(method: str, params: list, rpc_url: str = DEVNET_RPC) -> object:
53:     """POST one JSON-RPC request and return the result field.
54: 
55:     Defaults to devnet. Only the localnet self test passes another URL; the
56:     devnet default is what keeps every real run on the test cluster.
57:     """
58:     payload = json.dumps(
59:         {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": method, "params": params}
60:     ).encode("utf-8")
61:     request = urllib.request.Request(
62:         rpc_url,
63:         data=payload,
64:         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
65:     )
66:     with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
67:         body = json.load(response)
68:     if "error" in body:
69:         raise RuntimeError(f"RPC error for {method}: {body['error']}")
70:     return body["result"]

73: def assert_devnet_cluster(rpc_url: str = DEVNET_RPC) -> str:
74:     """Refuse to continue unless the endpoint really is devnet.
75: 
76:     The genesis hash is checked before any transaction is built, so a
77:     mistyped endpoint can never reach mainnet or testnet. Fail closed:
78:     an unexpected genesis hash stops the run with a clear message.
79:     """
80:     genesis = str(rpc_call("getGenesisHash", [], rpc_url))
81:     if genesis != DEVNET_GENESIS_HASH:
82:         raise RuntimeError(
83:             "Cluster guard failed: genesis hash "
84:             f"{genesis} does not match devnet {DEVNET_GENESIS_HASH}. "
85:             "Refusing to send. Devnet only, no real funds."
86:         )
87:     return genesis

91:     """Load a Solana CLI JSON keypair (64 byte array) from disk."""
92:     if not path.exists():
93:         raise FileNotFoundError(

95:             f"solana-keygen new --no-bip39-passphrase --outfile {path}"
96:         )

98:     return Keypair.from_bytes(bytes(secret_bytes))

101: def sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:
102:     """Return the lowercase hex SHA256 digest of data."""
103:     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

106: def build_memo_text(prefix: str, data: bytes) -> str:
107:     """Compose the on chain memo: prefix, then 'sha256:' plus the digest.
108: 
109:     The digest goes last so a reader can verify the exact hashed bytes
110:     against the file named in the prefix.

112:     memo_text = f"{prefix} sha256:{sha256_hex(data)}"

128: ) -> dict:

130:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
131:     while time.monotonic() < deadline:
132:         result = rpc_call(
133:             "getSignatureStatuses",
134:             [[signature], {"searchTransactionHistory": False}],
135:             rpc_url,
136:         )
137:         statuses = result.get("value") or [None]
138:         status = statuses[0]

145:                 return status

152: def read_memo_from_chain(
153:     signature: str, rpc_url: str = DEVNET_RPC

160:     the public devnet endpoint (error -32601), while getTransaction works in
161:     jsonParsed, base64, and json encodings and answers browser CORS preflight.
162:     """
163:     result = rpc_call(
164:         "getTransaction",
165:         [
166:             signature,
167:             {
168:                 "encoding": "jsonParsed",
169:                 "commitment": "confirmed",
170:                 "maxSupportedTransactionVersion": 0,
171:             },
172:         ],
173:         rpc_url,
174:     )
175:     if result is None:
176:         raise RuntimeError(f"getTransaction returned null for {signature}")
177:     slot = result["slot"]
178:     block_time = result.get("blockTime")
179:     for compiled in result["transaction"]["message"]["instructions"]:
180:         if (
181:             compiled.get("program") == "spl-memo"
182:             and compiled.get("programId") == str(MEMO_PROGRAM_ID)
183:         ):
184:             return slot, block_time, str(compiled["parsed"])
185:     raise RuntimeError(f"No Memo instruction found in transaction {signature}")

69:         raise RuntimeError(f"RPC error for {method}: {body['error']}")
70:     return body["result"]
71: 
72: 
73: def assert_devnet_cluster(rpc_url: str = DEVNET_RPC) -> str:
74:     """Refuse to continue unless the endpoint really is devnet.
75: 
76:     The genesis hash is checked before any transaction is built, so a
77:     mistyped endpoint can never reach mainnet or testnet. Fail closed:
78:     an unexpected genesis hash stops the run with a clear message.
79:     """
80:     genesis = str(rpc_call("getGenesisHash", [], rpc_url))
81:     if genesis != DEVNET_GENESIS_HASH:
82:         raise RuntimeError(
83:             "Cluster guard failed: genesis hash "
84:             f"{genesis} does not match devnet {DEVNET_GENESIS_HASH}. "
85:             "Refusing to send. Devnet only, no real funds."
86:         )
87:     return genesis
88: 
89: 
90: def load_keypair(path: Path) -> Keypair:
91:     """Load a Solana CLI JSON keypair (64 byte array) from disk."""
92:     if not path.exists():
93:         raise FileNotFoundError(
94:             f"No keypair at {path}. Create one with: "
95:             f"solana-keygen new --no-bip39-passphrase --outfile {path}"
96:         )
97:     secret_bytes = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
98:     return Keypair.from_bytes(bytes(secret_bytes))
99: 
100: 
101: def sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:
102:     """Return the lowercase hex SHA256 digest of data."""
103:     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
104: 
105: 
106: def build_memo_text(prefix: str, data: bytes) -> str:
107:     """Compose the on chain memo: prefix, then 'sha256:' plus the digest.
108: 
109:     The digest goes last so a reader can verify the exact hashed bytes
110:     against the file named in the prefix.
111:     """
112:     memo_text = f"{prefix} sha256:{sha256_hex(data)}"
113:     if DIGEST_RE.search(memo_text) is None:
114:         raise RuntimeError("Memo text does not carry a 64 hex character digest")
115:     return memo_text
116: 
117: 
118: def build_memo_transaction(payer: Keypair, memo_text: str, blockhash: Hash) -> bytes:
119:     """Build and sign a single instruction Memo transaction, return wire bytes."""
120:     instruction = Instruction(MEMO_PROGRAM_ID, memo_text.encode("utf-8"), [])
121:     transaction = Transaction.new_with_payer([instruction], payer.pubkey())
122:     transaction.sign([payer], blockhash)
123:     return bytes(transaction)
124: 
125: 
126: def wait_for_confirmation(
127:     signature: str, timeout_s: float, rpc_url: str = DEVNET_RPC
128: ) -> dict:
129:     """Poll getSignatureStatuses until confirmed or finalized, or raise."""
130:     deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
131:     while time.monotonic() < deadline:
132:         result = rpc_call(
133:             "getSignatureStatuses",
134:             [[signature], {"searchTransactionHistory": False}],
135:             rpc_url,
136:         )
137:         statuses = result.get("value") or [None]
138:         status = statuses[0]
139:         if status is not None:
140:             if status.get("err") is not None:
141:                 raise RuntimeError(
142:                     f"Transaction {signature} failed on chain: {status['err']}"
143:                 )
144:             if status.get("confirmationStatus") in ("confirmed", "finalized"):
145:                 return status
146:         time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_S)
147:     raise TimeoutError(
148:         f"Transaction {signature} not confirmed within {timeout_s:.0f}s"
149:     )
150: 
151: 
152: def read_memo_from_chain(
153:     signature: str, rpc_url: str = DEVNET_RPC
154: ) -> tuple[int, int | None, str]:
155:     """Fetch the confirmed transaction and read its Memo instruction.
156: 
157:     Returns (slot, block_time, memo_text) from getTransaction with encoding
158:     jsonParsed, so the read back comes from chain data rather than our local
159:     copy of the memo. The separate getParsedTransaction method is disabled on
160:     the public devnet endpoint (error -32601), while getTransaction works in
161:     jsonParsed, base64, and json encodings and answers browser CORS preflight.
162:     """
163:     result = rpc_call(
164:         "getTransaction",
165:         [
166:             signature,
167:             {
168:                 "encoding": "jsonParsed",
169:                 "commitment": "confirmed",
170:                 "maxSupportedTransactionVersion": 0,
171:             },
172:         ],
173:         rpc_url,
174:     )
175:     if result is None:
176:         raise RuntimeError(f"getTransaction returned null for {signature}")
177:     slot = result["slot"]
178:     block_time = result.get("blockTime")
179:     for compiled in result["transaction"]["message"]["instructions"]:
180:         if (
181:             compiled.get("program") == "spl-memo"
182:             and compiled.get("programId") == str(MEMO_PROGRAM_ID)
183:         ):
184:             return slot, block_time, str(compiled["parsed"])
185:     raise RuntimeError(f"No Memo instruction found in transaction {signature}")
186: 
187: 
188: def next_evidence_path(date_stamp: str) -> Path:
189:     """Return evidence/memo-<date>.json, adding a counter on collision."""
190:     EVIDENCE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
191:     candidate = EVIDENCE_DIR / f"memo-{date_stamp}.json"
192:     counter = 1
193:     while candidate.exists():
194:         candidate = EVIDENCE_DIR / f"memo-{date_stamp}-{counter}.json"
195:         counter += 1
196:     return candidate
197: 
198: 
199: def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
200:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
201:         description="Anchor a SHA256 digest in a Solana devnet Memo transaction."
202:     )
203:     source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
204:     source.add_argument(
205:         "--text",
206:         help="Plain text to hash (default: 'Ledger Odyssey test')",
207:     )
208:     source.add_argument(
209:         "--file",
210:         type=Path,
211:         help="File whose bytes are hashed (for example public/data/findings.json)",
212:     )
213:     parser.add_argument(
214:         "--prefix",
215:         help="Label placed in front of the digest inside the memo. "
216:         "Defaults to the file path or the hashed text.",
217:     )
218:     parser.add_argument(
219:         "--cluster",
220:         choices=["devnet"],
221:         default="devnet",
222:         help="Target cluster mode. Only devnet is accepted; localnet lives "
223:         "in localnet_selftest.py and mainnet is never used (no real funds).",
224:     )
225:     parser.add_argument(
226:         "--keypair",
227:         type=Path,
228:         default=DEFAULT_KEYPAIR,
229:         help=f"Keypair JSON path (default: {DEFAULT_KEYPAIR})",
230:     )
231:     parser.add_argument(
232:         "--evidence",
233:         type=Path,
234:         default=None,
235:         help="Evidence JSON output path (default: scripts/solana/evidence/memo-<date>.json)",
236:     )
237:     parser.add_argument(
238:         "--timeout",
239:         type=float,
240:         default=CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_S,
241:         help=f"Confirmation timeout in seconds (default: {CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_S:.0f})",
242:     )
243:     return parser.parse_args(argv)
244: 
245: 
246: def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
247:     args = parse_args(argv)
248: 
249:     if args.cluster != "devnet":
250:         raise RuntimeError(
251:             f"Cluster mode {args.cluster!r} is not allowed. Devnet only: "
252:             "no real funds, no financial data on chain."
253:         )
254: 
255:     if args.file is not None:
256:         data = args.file.read_bytes()
257:         source = f"file:{args.file.as_posix()}"
258:         default_prefix = args.file.as_posix()
259:     else:
260:         text = args.text if args.text is not None else "Ledger Odyssey test"
261:         data = text.encode("utf-8")
262:         source = f"text:{text}"
263:         default_prefix = text
264: 
265:     prefix = args.prefix if args.prefix is not None else default_prefix
266:     memo_text = build_memo_text(prefix, data)
267:     digest = sha256_hex(data)
268: 
269:     genesis = assert_devnet_cluster()
270:     print(f"Cluster:  devnet (genesis {genesis})")
271: 
272:     payer = load_keypair(args.keypair)
273:     print(f"Signer: {payer.pubkey()}")
274:     print(f"Source: {source}")
275:     print(f"SHA256: {digest}")
276: 
277:     balance = rpc_call("getBalance", [str(payer.pubkey())])
278:     lamports = int(balance["value"])
279:     if lamports < 5_000:
280:         raise RuntimeError(
281:             f"Devnet balance is {lamports} lamports, a transaction needs "
282:             "5000 lamports of fee. Funding order, AI agents must not use web "
283:             "faucets: (a) solana airdrop 2 "
284:             f"{payer.pubkey()} --url devnet (observed 2026-11-06: RPC error "
285:             "410, 'The RPC faucet is closed on this cluster'); "
286:             "(b) devnet-pow mine -d 3 --reward 0.02 --no-infer "
287:             "-t 5000000000, which itself needs 5000 lamports already in the "
288:             "wallet to pay the claim fee; (c) solana-test-validator plus "
289:             "solana airdrop 100 for offline testing only, local SOL never "
290:             "reaches devnet. A human operator may fund "
291:             f"{payer.pubkey()} once at https://faucet.solana.com."
292:         )
293:     print(f"Balance: {lamports} lamports (devnet)")
294: 
295:     latest = rpc_call(
296:         "getLatestBlockhash", [{"commitment": "finalized"}]
297:     )
298:     blockhash = Hash.from_string(latest["value"]["blockhash"])
299:     wire_bytes = build_memo_transaction(payer, memo_text, blockhash)
300: 
301:     signature = rpc_call(
302:         "sendTransaction",
303:         [
304:             base64.b64encode(wire_bytes).decode("ascii"),
305:             {"encoding": "base64", "skipPreflight": False, "commitment": "confirmed"},
306:         ],
307:     )
308:     print(f"Signature: {signature}")
309: 
310:     status = wait_for_confirmation(str(signature), args.timeout)
311:     slot, block_time, memo_on_chain = read_memo_from_chain(str(signature))
312: 
313:     if memo_on_chain != memo_text:
314:         raise RuntimeError(
315:             "On chain memo does not match what we sent: "
316:             f"{memo_on_chain!r} != {memo_text!r}"
317:         )
318: 
319:     local_date = datetime.now().astimezone().date().isoformat()
320:     evidence_path = (
321:         args.evidence if args.evidence is not None else next_evidence_path(local_date)
322:     )
323:     evidence = {
324:         "signature": str(signature),
325:         "slot": slot,
326:         "payload_sha256": digest,
327:         "cluster": "devnet",
328:         "program_id": str(MEMO_PROGRAM_ID),
329:         "rpc": DEVNET_RPC,
330:         "rpc_url": DEVNET_RPC,
331:         "confirmed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
332:         "confirmation_status": status["confirmationStatus"],
333:         "block_time": block_time,
334:         "explorer_url": (
335:             f"https://explorer.solana.com/tx/{signature}?cluster=devnet"
336:         ),
337:         "signer_pubkey": str(payer.pubkey()),
338:         "payload": {
339:             "algorithm": "sha256",
340:             "digest_hex": digest,
341:             "source": source,
342:             "memo_text": memo_text,
343:             "memo_program": str(MEMO_PROGRAM_ID),
344:         },
345:         "memo_text_on_chain": memo_on_chain,
346:         "matches_local": memo_on_chain == memo_text,
347:     }
348:     evidence_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
349:     evidence_path.write_text(
350:         json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
351:     )
352: 
353:     print(f"Confirmed: {status['confirmationStatus']} at slot {slot}")
354:     print(f"Explorer:  {evidence['explorer_url']}")
355:     print(f"Evidence:  {evidence_path}")
356:     return 0

93: interface Prose {
94:   file: string
95:   line: number
96:   chunk: string
97:   where: string
98: }
99: 
100: function lineOf(text: string, index: number): number {
101:   return text.slice(0, index).split('\n').length
102: }
103: 
104: /** Pull every piece of prose out of one source file. */
105: function proseOf(file: string, text: string): Prose[] {
106:   const prose: Prose[] = []
107:   let rest = text
108: 
109:   const push = (chunk: string, index: number, where: string): void => {
110:     prose.push({ file, line: lineOf(text, index), chunk, where })
111:   }
112: 
113:   // Block comments first, then line comments, so an apostrophe inside a
114:   // comment can never open a string that swallows real code.
115:   rest = rest.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, (chunk, index: number) => {
116:     push(chunk, index, 'block comment')
117:     return ' '
118:   })
119:   rest = rest.replace(/\/\/[^\n]*/g, (chunk, index: number) => {
120:     push(chunk, index, 'line comment')
121:     return ' '
122:   })
123: 
124:   const stringPattern = /'(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*'|"(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*"|`(?:[^`\\]|\\.)*`/g
125:   let match: RegExpExecArray | null
126:   while ((match = stringPattern.exec(rest)) !== null) {
127:     // Template expressions are code, not copy.
128:     const chunk = match[0].replace(/\$\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
129:     push(chunk, match.index, 'string literal')
130:   }
131:   rest = rest.replace(stringPattern, ' ')
132: 
133:   // JSX text nodes: prose between a tag close and the next tag open.
134:   const jsxPattern = />([^<>{}]+)</g
135:   while ((match = jsxPattern.exec(rest)) !== null) {
136:     const chunk = match[1] ?? ''
137:     if (PROSE.test(chunk) && /[A-Za-z]/.test(chunk)) {
138:       push(chunk, match.index, 'jsx text')
139:     }
140:   }
141: 
142:   return prose
143: }

158:   }
159:   if (chunk.includes(SPACED_HYPHEN)) {
160:     problems.push('spaced hyphen')
161:   }
162:   return problems
163: }

export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (role === undefined) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>

  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null

  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256) === false) return null

  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null

  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null

  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string' || explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/') === false) return null

  if (typeof record.matches_local !== 'boolean') return null

  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || source.startsWith('file:') === false) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null

  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,
    cluster: 'devnet',
    confirmedAt,
    explorerUrl,
    evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
    label: LABEL_BY_ROLE[role],
    matchesLocal: record.matches_local,
  }
}
```

const BUNDLED_EVIDENCE = import.meta.glob<{ default: unknown }>(
  '../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json',
  { eager: true },
)

/**
 * Every bundled receipt that parses, root first, then the model card,
 * then the F1 fingerprint. A file that is missing from public/data is
 * simply absent from the glob, and a file that fails the guard drops
 * out, so a gate failure ships the placeholder instead of a broken
 * build.
 */
export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED_EVIDENCE)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(module.default, filename)
    if (receipt !== null) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((left, right) => ROLE_ORDER[left.role] - ROLE_ORDER[right.role])
  return receipts
}

```ts
export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (!role) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>
  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null
  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256)) return null
  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null
  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at

const BUNDLED = import.meta.glob<unknown>('../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json', { eager: true })

const ROLE_ORDER: Record<ReceiptRole, number> = { root: 0, modelcard: 1, fingerprint: 2 }

export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {

  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED)) {

  return receipts
}

export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (role === undefined) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>

  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null

  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256) === false) return null

  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null

  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null

  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string' || explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/') === false) return null

  if (typeof record.matches_local !== 'boolean') return null

  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || source.startsWith('file:') === false) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null

  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,
    cluster: 'devnet',
    confirmedAt,
    explorerUrl,
    evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
    label: LABEL_BY_ROLE[role],
    matchesLocal: record.matches_local,
  }
}
```

const BUNDLED_EVIDENCE = import.meta.glob<{ default: unknown }>(
  '../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json',
  { eager: true },
)

/**
 * Every bundled receipt that parses, root first, then the model card,
 * then the F1 fingerprint. A file that is missing from public/data is
 * simply absent from the glob, and a file that fails the guard drops
 * out, so a gate failure ships the placeholder instead of a broken
 * build.
 */
export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED_EVIDENCE)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(module.default, filename)
    if (receipt !== null) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((left, right) => ROLE_ORDER[left.role] - ROLE_ORDER[right.role])
  return receipts
}
```

import type { MemoEvidence } from '../components/judge/ReceiptBadge'
import { dataBase } from './loaders'

/**
 * Phase E7 chain receipts: a typed, hand guarded view over the bundled
 * memo evidence files in public/data (docs/decisions.md, Phase E7; the
 * wording contract lives in docs/solana.md). The registry reads the
 * files through import.meta.glob eager, so every byte is inlined at
 * build time: no fetch, no RPC, no network call at runtime, which is
 * the hard rule for the bundled evidence. parseChainReceipt is a
 * hand written guard that returns null on any shape violation, so a
 * damaged file drops out of the registry and the badge falls back to
 * its placeholder instead of rendering a claim it cannot back up.
 */

/** One of the three approved receipts (docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). */
export type ReceiptRole = 'root' | 'modelcard' | 'fingerprint'

export interface ChainReceipt {
  role: ReceiptRole
  /** File whose bytes the on chain memo digest was computed over. */
  sourceFile: string
  signature: string
  payloadSha256: string
  cluster: string
  confirmedAt: string
  explorerUrl: string
  evidenceHref: string
  label: string
  matchesLocal: boolean
}

/** The evidence filename each receipt role ships under, root first. */
const ROLE_BY_FILENAME: Readonly<Record<string, ReceiptRole>> = {
  'memo-devnet.json': 'root',
  'memo-devnet-modelcard.json': 'modelcard',
  'memo-devnet-fingerprint.json': 'fingerprint',
}

/** The approved labels, one per receipt (docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). */
const LABEL_BY_ROLE: Record<ReceiptRole, string> = {
  root: 'findings.json root memo, devnet',
  modelcard: 'model_card.json hash, devnet',
  fingerprint: 'F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows',
}

/** Registry order: root first, then the model card, then the fingerprint. */
const ROLE_ORDER: Record<ReceiptRole, number> = { root: 0, modelcard: 1, fingerprint: 2 }

/** Bundled evidence link for one filename, base path aware. */
export function evidenceHref(filename: string): string {
  return `${dataBase()}data/${filename}`
}

/**
 * Parse one raw evidence object under a known filename. Returns null
 * when the filename is not a receipt, when the object is not an
 * object, or when any required field is missing or the wrong type:
 * a non empty signature, a 64 character lowercase hex digest, the
 * devnet cluster the labels promise, a non empty confirmation time,
 * an explorer link on the Solana explorer, a boolean matches_local,
 * and a payload source of the form file:<path>.
 */
export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (role === undefined) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>

  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null

  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256)) return null

  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null

  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null

  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string') return null
  if (!explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/')) return null

  const matchesLocal = record.matches_local
  if (typeof matchesLocal !== 'boolean') return null

  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || !source.startsWith('file:')) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null

  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,
    cluster: 'devnet',
    confirmedAt,
    explorerUrl,
    evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
    label: LABEL_BY_ROLE[role],
    matchesLocal,
  }
}

/** The bundled evidence modules Vite inlines at build time. */
const BUNDLED_EVIDENCE = import.meta.glob<{ default: unknown }>(
  '../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json',
  { eager: true },
)

/**
 * Every bundled receipt that parses, root first. A file missing from
 * public/data is simply absent from the glob, and a file that fails
 * the guard drops out, so a gate failure ships the honest placeholder
 * rather than a broken build.
 */
export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED_EVIDENCE)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(module.default, filename)
    if (receipt !== null) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((left, right) => ROLE_ORDER[left.role] - ROLE_ORDER[right.role])
  return receipts
}

/**
 * Map one receipt onto the badge evidence props: verified comes from
 * the build time read back recorded in matches_local, plus the
 * signature and the approved label. Null in, null out, so an absent
 * receipt renders the pinned placeholder.
 */
export function toMemoEvidence(receipt: ChainReceipt | null | undefined): MemoEvidence | null {
  if (!receipt) return null
  return {
    signature: receipt.signature,
    verified: receipt.matchesLocal,
    label: receipt.label,
  }
}

export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const raw = (module as { default?: unknown }).default
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(raw, filename)
    if (receipt) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((a, b) => ROLE_ORDER[a.role] - ROLE_ORDER[b.role])
  return receipts
}
```

export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (role === undefined) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>

  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null

  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256) === false) return null

  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null

  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null

  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string' || explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/') === false) return null

  if (typeof record.matches_local !== 'boolean') return null

  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || source.startsWith('file:') === false) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null

  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,
    cluster: 'devnet',
    confirmedAt,
    explorerUrl,
    evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
    label: LABEL_BY_ROLE[role],
    matchesLocal: record.matches_local,
  }
}
```

const BUNDLED_EVIDENCE = import.meta.glob<{ default: unknown }>(
  '../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json',
  { eager: true },
)

/**
 * Every bundled receipt that parses, root first, then the model card,
 * then the F1 fingerprint. A file that is missing from public/data is
 * simply absent from the glob, and a file that fails the guard drops
 * out, so a gate failure ships the placeholder instead of a broken
 * build.
 */
export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED_EVIDENCE)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(module.default, filename)
    if (receipt !== null) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((left, right) => ROLE_ORDER[left.role] - ROLE_ORDER[right.role])
  return receipts
}
```

```ts
export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (!role) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>
  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null
  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256)) return null
  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null
  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null
  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string' || !explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/')) return null
  if (typeof record.matches_local !== 'boolean') return null
  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || !source.startsWith('file:')) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice(5)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null
  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,
    cluster: record.cluster, // 'devnet'
    confirmedAt,
    explorerUrl,
    evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
    label: LABELS[role],
    matchesLocal: record.matches_local,
  }
}
```

const BUNDLED = import.meta.glob<unknown>('../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json', { eager: true })

const ROLE_ORDER: Record<ReceiptRole, number> = { root: 0, modelcard: 1, fingerprint: 2 }

export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const raw = (module as { default?: unknown }).default
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(raw, filename)
    if (receipt) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((a, b) => ROLE_ORDER[a.role] - ROLE_ORDER[b.role])
  return receipts
}

```ts
export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (role === undefined) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>

  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null

  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256) === false) return null

  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null

  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null

  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string' || explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/') === false) return null

  if (typeof record.matches_local !== 'boolean') return null

  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || source.startsWith('file:') === false) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null

  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,

export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {

 * wording contract lives in docs/solana.md). The registry reads the
 * files through import.meta.glob eager, so every byte is inlined at
 * build time: no fetch, no RPC, no network call at runtime, which is
 * the hard rule for the bundled evidence. parseChainReceipt is a
 * hand written guard that returns null on any shape violation, so a
 * damaged file drops out of the registry and the badge falls back to
 * its placeholder instead of rendering a claim it cannot back up.
 */

/** One of the three approved receipts (docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). */
export type ReceiptRole = 'root' | 'modelcard' | 'fingerprint'

export interface ChainReceipt {
  role: ReceiptRole
  /** File whose bytes the on chain memo digest was computed over. */
  sourceFile: string
  signature: string
  payloadSha256: string
  cluster: string
  confirmedAt: string
  explorerUrl: string
  evidenceHref: string
  label: string
  matchesLocal: boolean
}

/** The evidence filename each receipt role ships under, root first. */
const ROLE_BY_FILENAME: Readonly<Record<string, ReceiptRole>> = {
  'memo-devnet.json': 'root',
  'memo-devnet-modelcard.json': 'modelcard',
  'memo-devnet-fingerprint.json': 'fingerprint',
}

/** The approved labels, one per receipt (docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). */
const LABEL_BY_ROLE: Record<ReceiptRole, string> = {
  root: 'findings.json root memo, devnet',
  modelcard: 'model_card.json hash, devnet',
  fingerprint: 'F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows',
}

/** Registry order: root first, then the model card, then the fingerprint. */
const ROLE_ORDER: Record<ReceiptRole, number> = { root: 0, modelcard: 1, fingerprint: 2 }

/** Bundled evidence link for one filename, base path aware. */
export function evidenceHref(filename: string): string {
  return `${dataBase()}data/${filename}`
}

/**
 * Parse one raw evidence object under a known filename. Returns null
 * when the filename is not a receipt, when the object is not an
 * object, or when any required field is missing or the wrong type:
 * a non empty signature, a 64 character lowercase hex digest, the
 * devnet cluster the labels promise, a non empty confirmation time,
 * an explorer link on the Solana explorer, a boolean matches_local,
 * and a payload source of the form file:<path>.
 */
export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
  const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
  if (role === undefined) return null
  if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
  const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>

  const signature = record.signature
  if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null

  const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
  if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256)) return null

  if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null

  const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
  if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null

  const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
  if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string') return null
  if (!explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/')) return null

  const matchesLocal = record.matches_local
  if (typeof matchesLocal !== 'boolean') return null

  const payload = record.payload
  if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
  const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
  if (typeof source !== 'string' || !source.startsWith('file:')) return null
  const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
  if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null

  return {
    role,
    sourceFile,
    signature,
    payloadSha256,
    cluster: 'devnet',
    confirmedAt,
    explorerUrl,
    evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
    label: LABEL_BY_ROLE[role],
    matchesLocal,
  }
}

/** The bundled evidence modules Vite inlines at build time. */
const BUNDLED_EVIDENCE = import.meta.glob<{ default: unknown }>(
  '../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json',
  { eager: true },
)

/**
 * Every bundled receipt that parses, root first. A file missing from
 * public/data is simply absent from the glob, and a file that fails
 * the guard drops out, so a gate failure ships the honest placeholder
 * rather than a broken build.
 */
export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
  const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
  for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED_EVIDENCE)) {
    const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
    const receipt = parseChainReceipt(module.default, filename)
    if (receipt !== null) receipts.push(receipt)
  }
  receipts.sort((left, right) => ROLE_ORDER[left.role] - ROLE_ORDER[right.role])
  return receipts
}

/**
 * Map one receipt onto the badge evidence props: verified comes from
 * the build time read back recorded in matches_local, plus the
 * signature and the approved label. Null in, null out, so an absent
 * receipt renders the pinned placeholder.
 */
export function toMemoEvidence(receipt: ChainReceipt | null | undefined): MemoEvidence | null {
  if (!receipt) return null
  return {
    signature: receipt.signature,
    verified: receipt.matchesLocal,
    label: receipt.label,
  }
}

import { createElement } from 'react'
import { renderToString } from 'react-dom/server'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import type { ChainReceipt } from '../../data/receipts'
import { loadBundledReceipts } from '../../data/receipts'
import ReceiptStamp from './ReceiptStamp'

/**
 * Phase E7 receipt stamp: the badge sits inside an anchor to the local
 * evidence file with the honest tooltip, the explorer anchor opens the
 * frozen transaction, one compact row per receipt carries the label
 * and the first 8 signature characters, and the note states exactly
 * what the stamp does. With no receipts the badge falls back to its
 * pinned placeholder with zero rows and no chain claims. Server
 * rendering keeps this file free of a DOM: the stamp makes no
 * network call either way.
 */

const ROOT: ChainReceipt = {
  role: 'root',
  sourceFile: 'public/data/findings.json',
  signature: 'REDACTED',
  payloadSha256: '48bb57a409459812ae2bfead9ae688bf5d38b4c4786dabf15e1e05d52b8b3bc3',
  cluster: 'devnet',
  confirmedAt: '2026-11-07T02:47:12+00:00',
  explorerUrl: `https://explorer.solana.com/tx/REDACTED?cluster=devnet`,
  evidenceHref: '/data/memo-devnet.json',
  label: 'findings.json root memo, devnet',
  matchesLocal: true,
}

const MODEL_CARD: ChainReceipt = {
  ...ROOT,
  role: 'modelcard',
  sourceFile: 'public/data/model_card.json',
  signature:
    'REDACTED',
  payloadSha256: 'b3b32f0c0f284c3cac2e3df6e7d680fc53a5313b206750053f838853b9a0efe3',
  confirmedAt: '2026-11-08T06:43:55+00:00',
  explorerUrl:
    'https://explorer.solana.com/tx/REDACTED?cluster=devnet',
  evidenceHref: '/data/memo-devnet-modelcard.json',
  label: 'model_card.json hash, devnet',
}

const FINGERPRINT: ChainReceipt = {
  ...ROOT,
  role: 'fingerprint',
  sourceFile: 'build/f1-aggregate-table.json',
  signature:
    'REDACTED',
  payloadSha256: '84f5f24be8f1c74e3ca645fdebfd0f41e52f916c0cc84f6059ada2554138cccd',
  confirmedAt: '2026-11-08T06:44:11+00:00',
  explorerUrl:
    'https://explorer.solana.com/tx/REDACTED?cluster=devnet',
  evidenceHref: '/data/memo-devnet-fingerprint.json',
  label: 'F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows',
}

const ALL: ChainReceipt[] = [ROOT, MODEL_CARD, FINGERPRINT]

const NOTE =
  'Anchored at build time on Solana devnet when the analysis was frozen. ' +
  'This page reads the bundled evidence files only and never writes to chain.'

const EVIDENCE_TITLE = 'Bundled receipt, written at build time. Opens the local evidence file.'

function rowCount(html: string): number {
  return html.split('cp-receipt-row').length - 1
}

describe('ReceiptStamp markup', () => {
  it('anchors the badge to the local evidence file and the explorer', () => {
    const html = renderToString(createElement(ReceiptStamp, { receipts: ALL }))
    expect(html).toContain('Anchored on Solana devnet, verified')
    expect(html).toContain(`title="${EVIDENCE_TITLE}"`)
    expect(html).toContain(`href="${ROOT.evidenceHref}"`)
    expect(html).toContain(`href="${ROOT.explorerUrl}"`)
    expect(html).toContain('target="_blank"')
    expect(html).toContain('rel="noreferrer"')
    expect(html).toContain('data-state="verified"')
  })

  it('lists one compact row per receipt with labels and short signatures', () => {
    const html = renderToString(createElement(ReceiptStamp, { receipts: ALL }))
    expect(rowCount(html)).toBe(3)
    expect(html).toContain('findings.json root memo, devnet')
    expect(html).toContain('model_card.json hash, devnet')
    expect(html).toContain('F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows')
    expect(html).toContain(ROOT.signature.slice(0, 8))
    expect(html).toContain(MODEL_CARD.signature.slice(0, 8))
    expect(html).toContain(FINGERPRINT.signature.slice(0, 8))
    expect(html).toContain(`href="${MODEL_CARD.evidenceHref}"`)
    expect(html).toContain(`href="${FINGERPRINT.explorerUrl}"`)
    expect(html).toContain(NOTE)
  })

  it('routes a matches_local false receipt through the unverified path', () => {
    const unverified: ChainReceipt = { ...ROOT, matchesLocal: false }
    const html = renderToString(createElement(ReceiptStamp, { receipts: [unverified] }))
    expect(html).toContain(`anchored at build time, signature: ${unverified.signature}`)
    expect(html).not.toContain('Anchored on Solana devnet, verified')
    expect(rowCount(html)).toBe(1)
  })

  it('renders the placeholder with zero rows when there are no receipts', () => {
    const html = renderToString(createElement(ReceiptStamp, { receipts: [] }))
    expect(html).toContain('no evidence yet')
    expect(html).toContain('data-state="empty"')
    expect(rowCount(html)).toBe(0)
    expect(html).not.toContain('cp-receipt-note')
    expect(html).not.toContain('target="_blank"')
    expect(html).not.toContain('explorer.solana.com')
    expect(html).not.toContain('Anchored on Solana devnet')
  })

  it('defaults to the bundled registry', () => {
    const html = renderToString(createElement(ReceiptStamp))
    const receipts = loadBundledReceipts()
    expect(receipts.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(receipts[0]?.role).toBe('root')
    expect(rowCount(html)).toBe(receipts.length)
    expect(html).toContain('findings.json root memo, devnet')
    expect(html).toContain(NOTE)
  })
})
